message: My order arrived smashed. This is the SECOND time this has happened. I want a full refund right now or I am disputing with my bank and leaving reviews everywhere.
Delivery was a day late but the product itself is fine. Would just be good to get earlier updates next time.
You sent me the wrong colour. I ordered blue and got red. Can you send the correct one and arrange collection of this one?
I have been waiting three weeks for a response to my previous complaint. Nobody has called me back. I am contacting my solicitor if I do not hear back today.
My loyalty points haven't shown up yet for last week's order. Could you check when you have a moment?
The parcel came damaged and the replacement you sent was also scratched. I'd like this resolved properly.
My order arrived a day early, which was a nice surprise, but I was out and had to collect it from the depot.
The returns portal was a bit confusing. I got there in the end. Could the steps be clearer?
My discount code did not apply at checkout the first time. It worked on the second attempt. Might be worth a look.
I have reported this to my bank as fraud because you ignored my cancellation. My lawyer will be in touch.
The product works well, but the box was dented on one corner.
I would have liked a text message when the parcel was out for delivery.
Your product caused damage to my property. I am speaking to a solicitor about this and expect a response within 48 hours.
My parcel was delivered to a neighbour. They handed it over and no harm was done, but a notification would have been nice.
Your delivery service lost my parcel and then blamed me. I'm furious and I will be writing reviews and telling everyone I know.
Absolutely appalling service. My order was cancelled without notice and I want compensation. I'll be reporting this publicly.
I have been trying to reach someone about my return for days. Please can someone get back to me soon.
Is it possible to choose a delivery slot in future? I missed the courier this time but rebooked easily.
Quick note: my parcel arrived a few hours after the estimated window. Everything is fine, just letting you know.
The size guide on the site is hard to read on mobile. I ordered the right size in the end.
The item is fine, but the colour on screen looked lighter than it is in person. You might want to update the photos.
Please could you send my receipt as a PDF? The emailed link has expired.
I received the satisfaction survey twice for the same order. Not a problem, just a heads-up.
I've been overcharged and nobody will help me. If this isn't fixed I will dispute the charge with my card provider and post about it everywhere.
This is my final warning. I'm contacting trading standards and my solicitor about your refusal to refund a faulty item.
This is the second email I've sent about my missing accessory. I need it sent out this week please, as I'm travelling.
This is unacceptable. My order has arrived broken for the third time and I will be leaving a one-star review unless I get a full refund today.
Thanks for the quick delivery. One thing: the thank-you card inside had the wrong name on it.
The packaging was a bit bigger than it needed to be. The product itself is great though.
I paid for express delivery but the parcel took six days. I would like the delivery fee refunded.
The mug I ordered has a tiny chip on the handle. It's usable so there's no rush, but maybe let your packers know.
The item stopped working after two weeks. I'd like a replacement or a refund. It's quite frustrating.
The driver left the parcel at the side gate instead of the front door. It was fine, but a note would have helped.
My refund was promised in five working days and it's now day nine. Please sort this out today.
I'm completely fed up. Wrong item again, and I want a refund immediately or I'm taking this to the review sites.
Could you make the unsubscribe link easier to find in your emails? I found it eventually.
I received two copies of the same order confirmation email. No problem, just thought you should know.
Could you add the tracking link to the dispatch email? I had to log in to find it.
I ordered a medium and it fits fine, but the label says large. Just a labelling mix-up I think.
Two of the four items I ordered are missing from the box. I need them sent promptly, I'm quite annoyed.
I have been charged twice and my bank has told me to dispute it. If it isn't refunded by tomorrow I'm raising a chargeback and contacting a solicitor.
My package arrived with a torn outer wrapper, but the item inside is undamaged.
One of the items in my order is a slightly different shade from the website photo. Not a big deal but I wanted to mention it.
The wrong item arrived, and when I called I was told someone would ring me back. Nobody has. Please fix this soon.
The instruction leaflet was missing from the box. Is there a PDF I can download?
My invoice shows my old address. Could you update it when you get a chance? The order arrived at the right place.
I demand a refund today. This is the fourth time something has gone wrong and I'm done being polite. I'll leave honest reviews.
The phone number on my receipt looks like it has a typo. I found the right one online.
The website said in stock but my item took an extra two days to ship. It would be good if the estimate was more accurate.
Delivery took five days instead of the three quoted. It arrived fine, just a bit slower than expected.
The return label you emailed printed a bit faint. The courier still scanned it.
The font in the order confirmation email is very small. A slightly larger size would help.
My package was left in the recycling bin outside. I found it, but a safer spot might be better.
I tried your live chat this morning and it was closed. The email reply came back quickly, so no problem.
The item I received was clearly used, with fingerprints and dust inside the box. I expect better and want a fresh unit.
I was charged a restocking fee on a return that was your mistake. I'd like it refunded, it's not fair.
The faulty heater damaged my carpet. My solicitor has advised me to put this in writing and I expect compensation. I'll go to the small claims court if necessary.
The password reset email took about ten minutes to arrive. It worked fine in the end.
The replacement filter I ordered fits well. The packaging said fragile on a part that isn't, which worried me for no reason.
I'd like to change the name on my warranty registration from my husband's to mine when you have time.
The courier said they attempted delivery but I was home all day. I'm quite annoyed and need the parcel redelivered tomorrow.
My subscription renewal email arrived the same day as the charge. A few days' notice would be friendlier.
Just flagging that the track my order page showed my parcel as delivered a few hours before it really arrived.
My order was split into two deliveries a day apart. Both arrived fine, but a single parcel would have been neater.
Unacceptable. The charger overheated and scorched my table. I want a full refund immediately or I will be warning others in public reviews.
The survey link in your email doesn't open on my phone. I'll fill it in on my laptop.
The product description says it ships in 24 hours but mine shipped in 36. It arrived fine, just slightly off.
You have charged me three times for one order and ignored my emails. I'm furious. Fix this today or I'm disputing it with my card company.
The hinge on the box is stiff, but it works. Maybe worth checking with the supplier.
The gift wrapping was lovely, but the gift receipt was left out. Could you email me one?
I've been waiting a month for my money back and nobody cares. Refund me today or I will dispute the payment and tell everyone about this.
The price on the shelf label in your store was different from the website. The cashier sorted it straight away.
My monthly statement lists the charge under a different company name than I expected. It's correct, just confusing at first glance.
I was sent a reminder about an abandoned basket for something I already bought. Slightly annoying, nothing more.
I cancelled my subscription last month and I've been charged again. Please refund this and confirm the cancellation.
The coffee machine I bought leaks from the base after three uses. I'm disappointed and would like a replacement.
My bank has already started a chargeback because you refused to answer. If I don't have a refund and an explanation within 24 hours, my solicitor will write to you.
A nice product, but the manual is only in English. A French version would be helpful for my mother.
The colour name sand on the site looks quite different from beige. A swatch would help.
The tote bag I ordered has a loose thread on one strap. It isn't coming apart, just something for quality control.
This is the worst service I've had. My order has been wrong three times and I want a full refund now, or I'll be posting reviews everywhere.
The free sample that came with my order was lovely. Could I buy it separately? I couldn't find it on the site.
Your app logged me out twice this week. Easy to log back in, but I thought you'd want to know.
I was asked to rate my delivery before the parcel had actually arrived. Odd timing, but no problem.
Could you let me know if you will restock the green version? No hurry, I'm happy to wait.
I think the product page is missing the dimensions in centimetres. I worked it out from the inches.
I've been misled by your support team twice. I want a full refund today, or I'm taking this to the review sites and social media.
The checkout page kept my old billing address pre-filled. I corrected it, so no harm done.
You cancelled my wedding order two days before the date with no warning. I'm livid and I'll be sharing this on every review site I can find.
I was promised a call from a manager and it never came. Please make sure someone contacts me by tomorrow.
I have now contacted you twice about a faulty zip on my jacket and heard nothing. I'd like a replacement or refund this week.
I'm done. Late again, damaged again, and a rude person on your phone line. I want a refund and I'll be telling everyone.
The website offered me a discount on a product I had bought at full price the day before. No complaint, just an observation.
Thank you for the speedy delivery. A small thing: the order number on the packing slip had one digit missing.
I was told my refund would arrive within a week. It's been three and I've had no explanation. Please look into it.
My replacement arrived with the wrong power adaptor. This is the second time something has been wrong with my order and I'd like it sorted soon.
I have reported your company to trading standards and my lawyer is preparing a letter about the unsafe product you sold me.
I would like a copy of the VAT receipt for my last order. There's no rush.
Your support line kept me on hold for forty minutes and then cut me off. I need a callback today about my order.
The email greeted me with my surname instead of my first name. Easy mistake, just letting you know.
